difficulty_reason: Computing sections over a flat finitely presented U as hocolims of perfect objects on X: reduces RGamma(U, Lf^*K) = RGamma(X, Rf_*O_U ⊗ K) by the cohomology base change lemma, observes RGamma and ⊗K commute with hocolims (direct-sum arguments in span), reduces to writing Rf_*O_U = hocolim E_n; then the limit presentation A = colim A_i with descent of finite presentation and flatness, transfers the identity through lemma-compare-base-change and colimit commutation of Lg^*, and finishes over Z by lemma-countable plus countable sections of R^i f_*O_U from lemma-countable-cohomology.
